threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the fruit and veg from Ridley Road Market is overpriced. Wait until you really get into it!
Caught a glimpse on the 196 last night; a guy in a leopard print onesie arguing with a mannequin. Only in Brixton, I swear.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Standing in the middle of the tempelhof park, I realized I was truly home when I saw two guys arguing about the best Döner on Sonnenallee.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a techno party that starts at noon on a Sunday and ends with a sunrise jam in an abandoned warehouse. It’s wild.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they handle a BART delay; the stressed face means they're not surprised, just rolling their eyes at the same old song.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus with a guy reciting Shakespeare. Riders were too tired to care. Only in San Francisco do you get a free show on your commute.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always think the plaça is just for photos. It's actually the locals' living room—watching kids play and friends gather is where the real vibe is.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their bewilderment at the number of tapas options on every corner, while locals have already settled on their favorites.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You ask for directions to the nearest Tube and get a blank stare—it's all buses and Overground round here, mate.
Last night, a guy serenaded the whole bus with classic Queen, and somehow everyone joined in. Best 15 minutes I’ve had on the N75.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids making a mini-water park out of the fountain in the park, laughing like the world was theirs. Just felt so Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a karaoke bar tucked in a laundromat, where you can belt out 90s hits while waiting for your spin cycle.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know you’re local when you can spot a tourist by how they look at a BART delay like it’s an alien invasion instead of just another Tuesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy juggling while waiting for the 49 at Ellis. He managed to keep it up for a solid five minutes before the bus finally arrived.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just hop on Rodalies anytime, not knowing about the constant strikes. The locals have a backup plan, but they seem lost without their Google Maps.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always insist on asking for a ‘café con leche’ instead of just a ‘café’. Locals know it’s just coffee here.
